title: Public GitHub resources for FEUP LEIC and historical MIEIC
scope: Public GitHub only. Current 2026/27 LEIC courses plus relevant historical MIEIC equivalents.
methodology: Bounded repository and code searches split by course cluster.
Candidate verification from GitHub metadata, README files, repository trees and selected exact paths.
Forks and obvious archive/index relationships were not inflated into independent evidence.
No outreach, private repository access, Moodle access or large candidate clones.

2026-10-01 local acquisition: 67 repositories from this inventory plus 7 official author companions, pinned to remote HEAD commit. Originals and archive-member hashes are indexed privately; public metadata contains no student filenames or identifiers.
historical_mapping_notes: CMAT is relevant to current AM II.
AOCO is relevant to AC, but its ARMv7 material is not a drop-in match for the current RISC-V course.
TCOM is relevant to current TC, although its old curricular placement and ordering may differ.
PLOG covers only the logic/Prolog side of current PFL, not its functional/Haskell side.
The search did not establish IPM as a separate historical FEUP name equivalent to IPC.
